description: The one concrete platform profile shipped in this repository (issue #69). Fields marked "verified": true were fetched directly from the cited official Google Support page on 2026-09-19 - see each field's "source". Fields marked "verified": false are third-party-reported or estimated values that were NOT found on an official Google page as of that date; lib/omes/py/content/validation.py treats them as advisory (warnings, never publish-blocking errors) for exactly that reason. Re-verify all of this against https://support.google.com/youtube before relying on it for a real publish, since platform limits change without notice.

title_max_length.source: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57404 (fetched 2026-09-19): "Video titles have a character limit of 100 characters and cannot include invalid characters."

description_max_length.source: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57404 (fetched 2026-09-19): "Video descriptions have a character limit of 5,000 characters and cannot include invalid characters."

max_count.note: Widely reported by third-party SEO sites (e.g. more than 15 hashtags across title+description are reportedly all ignored by YouTube) as of 2026-09-19, but not confirmed on an official Google Support page during this review - treated as a warning, not a hard block, until verified.
YouTube does not appear to publish an explicit maximum link count in a video description - not verified either way; only syntax validation is enforced for this platform.

required.note: A custom thumbnail is optional on YouTube in the general case, but eligibility can depend on channel standing; not verified as an absolute rule.

formats.note: Commonly cited thumbnail formats; not independently re-verified against an official page during this review - verify before relying on this list.

recommended_resolution.note: Commonly cited recommended thumbnail resolution; verify against platform docs.

required_disclosures.message: caption mentions an affiliate/discount link or code but includes no sponsored/#ad disclosure; YouTube requires disclosure of paid promotions (verify current wording requirements against YouTube's advertiser-friendly guidelines before publishing)
